summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (with generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, added autodoc entries in docs/source/losses.rst, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py. Default distance matrix is 1 - I, which reduces to GeneralizedDiceLoss(w_type="square"). Nothing was run or committed; the math follows my reading of Fidon et al. (2017) and has not been checked against the paper or reference code.
